standard.summary: 训练加载时把 LTX-2.3 的 双流（视频+音频）transformer_blocks（原生 48） 交错复制扩到更多层数，每个 block 的 8 个输出投影（注意力 to_out[0] 与 FFN ff.net[2]，含 bias）全部归零，使新增层以恒等残差初始化，得到一个更深的可训练底座。仅支持全参微调（ltx23-finetune）。
standard.effect: 模型按 ltx23_depth_expansion_target_layers 重建为更深结构，初始行为与原模型一致（新层输出归零）；训练范围由 ltx23_depth_expansion_train_scope 控制；保存的产物是完整扩层底座。视频与音频双流在同一 block 内，扩层保持两流同步加深。22B 模型全参/扩层显存与磁盘开销极大。
standard.whenToUse: 想以较低成本扩大模型容量（Depth Up-Scaling 路线）、在原模型能力基础上继续拉伸上限时；准备做扩层后长期微调的项目。
standard.avoidWhen: LoRA 训练不支持；显存与磁盘按扩层后的层数计费，请先评估资源；从扩层 checkpoint 恢复训练时必须保持相同的扩层配置（层数不匹配后端会明确报错）。

standard_en.summary: At load time, interleaves copies of LTX-2.3's dual-stream (video+audio) transformer_blocks (48 natively) up to a larger count, zeroing all 8 output projections in each block (attention to_out[0] and FFN ff.net[2], bias included) so each new layer starts as an identity residual. The result is a deeper trainable base. Full finetune only (ltx23-finetune).
standard_en.effect: The model is rebuilt to the deeper shape given by ltx23_depth_expansion_target_layers, and initially behaves exactly like the original (the new layers output zero). What gets trained is set by ltx23_depth_expansion_train_scope, and the saved artefact is the whole expanded base. The video and audio streams live inside the same block, so expansion deepens both in step. Full-parameter and expanded training of a 22B model costs an enormous amount of VRAM and disk.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want more model capacity at relatively low cost (the Depth Up-Scaling route) and want to push past the original model's ceiling, or for a project that will finetune the expanded base over the long term.
standard_en.avoidWhen: LoRA training does not support it. VRAM and disk are billed at the expanded layer count, so size up your resources first. Resuming from an expanded checkpoint requires the same expansion config -- a layer-count mismatch raises an explicit backend error.

advanced.principle: Depth Up-Scaling（如 SOLAR 的做法）：交错复制已有 transformer 层构造更深网络，把新层的输出投影零初始化使残差路径退化为恒等，保证扩层瞬间模型输出不变，训练从「无损起点」开始学习新增容量。
advanced.intervention: ltx23/ltx23_depth_expansion_runtime.py：加载时执行交错复制与零投影，并把扩层元数据写入 adapter manifest；trainer_resume_runtime.py：LoRA 挂载扩层底座时按 manifest 校验层数（不匹配失败关闭）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 参数量与显存按层数比例上升；扩层容量需要足够数据与步数才能兑现为质量收益。
advanced.tradeoffs: 产物是完整底座（体积大，非 LoRA）；扩层模型的推理成本永久上升；训练范围选 all 时成本最高、选 new_layers 最接近标准 DUS 配方。
advanced.codePath: ltx23/ltx23_depth_expansion_runtime.py：扩层执行；trainer_prepare_train_mode_mixin.py：全参分支与训练范围

advanced_en.principle: Depth Up-Scaling (as in SOLAR): interleaves and duplicates existing transformer layers to build a deeper network, zero-initializing the new layers' output projections so the residual path degrades to identity — the model's output is unchanged at the instant of expansion, and training learns the new capacity from a lossless starting point.
advanced_en.intervention: ltx23/ltx23_depth_expansion_runtime.py: performs interleaved duplication and zero projection at load and writes expansion metadata into the adapter manifest; trainer_resume_runtime.py: when mounting a LoRA onto an expanded base, validates layer count against the manifest (mismatch fails closed).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Parameters and VRAM rise proportionally with layer count; the expanded capacity needs enough data and steps to convert into quality gains.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The artifact is a full base model (large, not a LoRA); inference cost of the expanded model rises permanently; train_scope=all is the most expensive and new_layers is closest to the standard DUS recipe.
advanced_en.codePath: ltx23/ltx23_depth_expansion_runtime.py: expansion execution; trainer_prepare_train_mode_mixin.py: full-parameter branch and training scope
